title: Septic Service Work Order
subtitle: Residential Septic Service: connects authorized scope to results.
description: Septic Service Work Order covers tank, inlet, outlet, baffle, pump, alarm, distribution component, and disposal area. The septic service coordinator records Residential Septic Service authorized tasks, materials, results, and changes. Septic Service Work Order keeps Residential Septic Service exceptions visible until the septic service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Septic Service Work Order at property, tank access, pump chamber, distribution area, and protected ground surface. Document tank, inlet, outlet, baffle, pump, alarm, distribution component, and disposal area identity before Residential Septic Service begins. Compare tank, inlet, outlet, baffle, pump, alarm, distribution component, and disposal area findings with stated Residential Septic Service criteria; route unresolved Residential Septic Service issues to qualified septic-system reviewer. For Septic Service Work Order, confirm requirements for Residential Septic Service. Ask qualified septic-system reviewer to review Residential Septic Service conditions beyond the septic service coordinator's role.

sections.title: Residential work exception and changes
sections.guidance: Stop Residential Septic Service at any scope or cost limit; honor septic service coordinator access and safety boundaries.

blocks.label: Do not proceed without control
blocks.guidance: Stop normal processing when access safety, containment, backup, structural integrity, disposal, or qualified escalation remains unresolved. Protect tank, inlet, outlet, baffle, pump, alarm, distribution component, and disposal area; document the Residential Septic Service notification and await qualified septic-system reviewer direction.

blocks.label: Conditions requiring stop or renewed authorization
items: Unsafe opening, fall, biological, or confined-space exposure
Backup or surfacing effluent threatens occupancy
Damaged tank or component requires excavation
Electrical, structural, or regulatory work outside scope
blocks.guidance: For Residential Septic Service, identify affected tank, inlet, outlet, baffle, pump, alarm, distribution component, and disposal area scope; ask septic service coordinator to document the Residential Septic Service immediate control before continuing.
